name: Guard One Reports Attack Over Radio
description: The world tilts sideways. Rain falls in the form of deposit slips. Guard One grabs the radio microphone and shouts into it: 'We're being taken down!'
related_events: Guard One reports being taken down over radio

name: Man Enters Apartment and Discards Coat
description: The man unlocks the door and steps into his apartment. He shrugs off his coat and throws it toward a chair.
related_events: Man enters apartment and discards coat

name: Coughing Man Reaches for the Door
description: He begins to cough violently. The mask over his face offers no relief. He stumbles forward, reaching for the door.
related_events: Character experiences mask failure and attempts to reach the door

name: Vehicle Smashes Into Gas Station
description: A vehicle slams sideways into the gas station, careening into two cars that are filling up, plowing through a rack of fuel pumps, destroying the air and water reservoirs, and finally wrapping itself around a lamppost.
related_events: Vehicle crashes into gas station and collides with multiple objects

name: The Armored Truck Arrives
description: The armored truck rumbles forward, drawing closer to the target location. Inside, Neil breathes steadily, his voice calm. 'We ought to be down the chute into the escape route in 2:20,' he says. A pause. 'Here we go.'
related_events: Armored truck approaches target location

name: Morning Intimacy in the Condominium
description: Justine lies in bed with her husband, Vincent Hanna, in their expensive condominium. It is morning. Their bodies move together beneath white sheets, entwined in a slow, quiet rhythm. Her auburn hair mingles with his as they press their faces close, eyes closed. A shower runs off screen.
related_events: Justine and Hanna engage in intimate lovemaking in the morning

name: Armored Truck Driver Brakes to Avoid Erratic Vehicle
description: A vehicle suddenly swerves diagonally across a narrow street, attempting a three-point turn. The driver of the armored truck reacts by slamming on the brakes, bringing the vehicle to a halt just in time to avoid a collision.
related_events: Armored truck driver slams on brakes to avoid collision

name: Cerrito Rams Armored Truck with Garbage Truck
description: Cerrito speeds forward in the garbage truck, driving it straight at the armored truck. The garbage truck slams into the armored vehicle, striking it with enough force to knock it onto its side. The armored truck skids and crashes against a wall, crumpling under the impact.
related_events: Cerrito accelerates the garbage truck toward the armored truck
Garbage truck collides with armored truck

name: Waingro Finishes Coffee and Tosses the Cup
description: Waingro drinks the last of his take-out coffee. He crumples the empty container and tosses it aside. The truck remains parked. The two men sit without speaking.
related_events: Waingro finishes drinking take-out coffee
Waingro tosses empty coffee container

name: Group Exits Vehicle and Moves to Chevrolet Caprice
description: The group steps out of their original vehicle, leaving masks, rubber gloves, equipment, and outer clothing inside. They walk to a Chevrolet Caprice parked nearby, open the doors, and climb in. The car starts up and pulls away from the scene.
related_events: Group abandons vehicle and leaves equipment behind
Group transfers to Chevrolet Caprice and departs

name: Police Vehicle Skids into Side Street, Officer Raises Shotgun
description: The police vehicle screeches into a narrow side street, tires skidding as it veers between a garbage truck and a wall. Dust and noise fill the air as the vehicle comes to a halt. One officer is already on scene, standing firm with his shotgun raised toward a target off-screen.
related_events: Police vehicle skids into side street in emergency mode
Officer raises shotgun during confrontation

name: Neil Reports Timing Failure and Initiates Contingency
description: Neil checks his watch, counts down from ten to nine, and hurls the watch aside. He grabs the walkie-talkie and tells Towner, 'Blew the margin. Here we come.'
related_events: Neil tosses his watch in disgust
Neil reports blown margin over walkie-talkie to Towner

name: Neil and Chris flee the hospital in an ambulance
description: Neil drives the ambulance away from the hospital with Chris sitting beside him in the front seat. As they leave the hospital grounds, Neil tells Chris to turn off the radio. Chris reaches over and switches it off. The cabin falls silent, and a quiet tension begins to build between them.
related_events: Neil drives ambulance away from hospital with Chris
Chris turns off radio after Neil's request

name: Neil McCauley Arrives on Beverly and Changes into Disguise
description: Neil McCauley and a nurse step off a bus on Beverly. Neil carries a paper bag and wears white pants. He walks through a set of double doors into a building, opens the bag, and takes out a white intern's coat, putting it on.
related_events: Neil McCauley and nurse disembark from bus on Beverly
Neil McCauley enters building and retrieves intern's coat from paper bag

name: Responding to a Call at Hoover and 14th
description: The dispatcher calls out to Car 74, directing them to respond to an in-progress incident at Hoover and 14th. Car 74 replies over the radio, reporting they will arrive in three minutes. Towner listens, then turns to Neil and relays the information: the unit is three minutes out.
related_events: Police dispatcher assigns Car 74 to respond to an in-progress incident
Car 74 reports three-minute estimated time of arrival
Towner relays police call information to Neil

name: Waingro Prepares to Leave After Washing
description: Waingro stands bare-chested at a sink, washing himself. He combs his long hair straight back off his round forehead. Dressed in gray workman's clothes from an Army and Navy store, he tucks in his shirt and puts on wraparound sunglasses. A large Aryan Brotherhood swastika covers his abdomen, visible beneath the tattoos that mark his skin. He is a 27-year-old graduate of the Chino and Tracy gladiator academies.
related_events: Waingro washes himself at a sink while bare-chested
Waingro combs his long hair straight back
Waingro tucks in his shirt and puts on wraparound sunglasses

name: Towner and Neil Begin High-Speed Evasion
description: Towner fastens a professional racing harness inside the vehicle. He speaks into the radio, reporting that a police car is behind them. Neil's voice is heard over the scanner, saying, 'Here we come.' Towner drops the walkie-talkie out the window. The vehicle speeds away.
related_events: Towner activates professional racing harness
Towner discards walkie-talkie from vehicle
Towner reports pursuit over police scanner
Neil announces arrival via voiceover

name: Neil's Quiet Farewell to Eady
description: Neil wakes and dresses quietly, watching Eady as she sleeps. He places a glass of water wrapped in a paper napkin on the bedside table, then gently pulls the covers up to her chin. He stands at the foot of the bed, looking at her for a long moment before he leaves.
related_events: Neil observes Eady sleeping after waking up
Neil places a glass of water on the bedside table
Neil adjusts the bed covers over Eady

name: Officer Rises as Reinforcements Arrive After Crash
description: An officer with a cut on his forehead struggles to stand. More police cars pull up, their lights flashing. The driver stumbles out from behind the wheel, dazed, and sits down on the pavement.
related_events: Injured officer attempts to stand after crash
Additional police vehicles arrive at crash scene
Driver emerges from vehicle and loses balance

name: Towner Rams Police Car with Towtruck
description: Towner drives a Chevy towtruck down the street as an ambulance speeds past with flashers on. A black and white police car rounds the corner sharply, its rear end sliding out as it skids to the left. Towner accelerates, driving the towtruck straight toward the police car. The heavy front bumper of the towtruck slams into the side of the police vehicle, shoving it sideways with force.
related_events: Towtruck operator accelerates vehicle toward police car
Police car skids after cornering sharply
Towtruck rams police car with front bumper

name: Hanna and Casals Exchange Investigation Updates
description: Hanna receives a call from Casals while moving through the dim glow of a green xenon light. Casals tells him that word is spreading about someone fencing stolen Bearer Bonds, but no one knows who’s behind it—rumors suggest the person might be high-level or from out of town. He adds that Schwartz reviewed recent surveillance tapes but found nothing: no armored cars, no witnesses to the ambulance theft. Hanna interrupts to ask if Albert Torena has called back. Casals says no.
related_events: Casals reports bond fencing rumors to Hanna
Casals checks surveillance tapes for clues
Hanna inquires about Albert Torena's callback

name: Neil Exits Hospital in Ambulance
description: Neil walks through a long, crowded hospital corridor, moving steadily past patients, nurses, interns, and doctors. A public address system announces intermittent messages. As he passes under an 'EMERGENCY' sign, two ambulance attendants wheel an elderly man on oxygen past him. Without stopping, Neil continues to the exit doors, steps outside, scans four parked ambulances, opens the door of one, climbs in, and drives away.
related_events: Neil walks through crowded hospital corridor
Neil passes ambulance attendants wheeling an elderly patient
Neil exits hospital and enters ambulance

name: Cerrito and Waingro Meet in the Truck
description: Michael Cerrito drives the truck as Waingro approaches and climbs in. Cerrito asks if he is Waingro, and Waingro replies, 'Yeah.' Waingro then reaches out to shake Cerrito's hand, but Cerrito is in the middle of a gear change and has to wait before he can respond. The engine is loud and poorly tuned, forcing them to speak loudly to be heard. Cerrito tells Waingro to follow Neil's instructions exactly, emphasizing each word over the noise.
related_events: Waingro introduces himself to Cerrito
Cerrito waits to shake Waingro's hand due to gear change

name: Waingro Questions Neil's Authority, Cerrito Insists on Following Orders
description: Waingro climbs into the vehicle and offers his hand, but Cerrito is delayed in responding as he finishes shifting gears. Over the loud noise of the struggling engine, Waingro shouts, asking if Cerrito is the one he’s supposed to meet. Cerrito confirms it. Waingro then yells, asking what kind of person Neil is. Cerrito replies loudly, telling him to do exactly as Neil says, word for word.
related_events: Waingro asks Cerrito about Neil
Cerrito instructs Waingro to follow Neil's directions exactly

name: Chris and Neil's Final Preparations
description: Chris checks the chamber of his 9mm Browning and inserts a 14-shot clip into the grip. He works the slide of a Remington 810, 12-gauge shotgun and puts on a welder's helmet. Neil pulls on the rubber mask of Donald Duck and slings a stopwatch on a string around his neck. He states the response time as two minutes, fifty seconds.
related_events: Chris loads 14-shot clip into 9mm Browning grip
Chris works slide of Remington 810 shotgun
Chris puts on welder's helmet
Neil pulls on Donald Duck rubber mask
Neil slings stopwatch on string around neck
Neil reports two minutes fifty seconds response time

name: Cerrito Returns Home with a Gift
description: Cerrito pulls his black '93 Eldorado into the driveway of his remodeled West L.A. bungalow, parking behind a 1990 Coupe de Ville. He gets out and opens the trunk, pulling out a wrapped doll house. As he does, a neighbor shuts off his sprinkler. Anita Cerrito, age 7, runs toward her father, calling out, 'Daddy, daddy!' and jumps into his arms. Her sister Linda, age 9, follows close behind.
related_events: Cerrito arrives at remodeled bungalow in West L.A.
Neighbor turns off sprinkler system
Cerrito retrieves wrapped doll house from trunk
Anita Cerrito runs to greet her father
Linda Cerrito follows Anita to greet Cerrito

name: Towner Monitors the Airwaves
description: Neil's voice comes through the radio, asking if Towner is ready. Towner, sitting in the tow truck, responds quietly, confirming he has the crew's air channel. Under the dash, the Bearcat 210 scanner hums softly, picking up faint police calls. He waits, slouched behind the wheel, the walkie-talkie at his side. The truck is still, the only sound the low murmur of the scanner and the occasional voice over the radio.
related_events: Neil communicates with Towner via radio to confirm readiness
Towner confirms he has the crew's air covered
Towner waits quietly in the tow truck monitoring police radio

name: Cerrito and Waingro Smoke and Exchange Words
description: Cerrito lights a cigarette and offers one to Waingro, who takes it and lights up. The two men sit together, smoking in silence beneath the curling blue smoke. Waingro asks if they always work together. Cerrito says they do, all the time. Waingro remarks on how tight the crew seems. After a pause, he asks if he could go again, but Cerrito tells him to stop talking. Waingro falls silent and taps his fingers on the dashboard.
related_events: Cerrito lights a cigarette and offers one to Waingro
Waingro and Cerrito smoke in silence under blue smoke swirls
Waingro asks if the crew always works together
Cerrito confirms they work together all the time
Waingro comments on the tightness of the crew
Waingro drums fingernails on the dashboard out of anxiety

name: Chris Shiherlis and Neil McCauley as Cellmates at San Quentin
description: Chris Shiherlis and Neil McCauley are incarcerated together at San Quentin Penitentiary from 1984 until an unspecified year. They share a cell and spend their days inside the prison, forming a bond that lasts beyond their time behind bars.
related_events: Chris Shiherlis and McCauley serve time as cellmates in San Quentin Penitentiary

name: Chris Shiherlis Buys a Hollow Core Drill After Prison
description: Chris Shiherlis walks past stacks of gravel and cement with a white-coated clerk. He wears a hard hat, Levi's, black boots, and a sleeveless sweatshirt, and carries a 150-pound red Milwaukee Tool Company case on one shoulder. They head toward the sales counter. In 1988, after being released from San Quentin, Chris returns to civilian life and buys a hollow core drill.
related_events: Chris Shiherlis is released from prison and returns to civilian life

name: Chris Shiherlis Buys a Hollow Core Drill
description: Chris Shiherlis walks past stacks of gravel and cement with a white-coated Black clerk. He wears a hard hat, Levi's, black boots, and a sleeveless sweatshirt, carrying a heavy red Milwaukee tool case on one shoulder. They approach the sales counter, where Chris completes the purchase of a hollow core drill.
related_events: Chris Shiherlis and the Black clerk approach the sales counter
Chris Shiherlis purchases a hollow core drill

name: Cerrito Buys a Doll House for His Daughters
description: Michael Cerrito stands looking at a doll house, three feet long and two feet high, with small room sets inside. His thick fingers close the tiny door. He lifts the house and carries it to the counter where a middle-aged clerk waits. He tells the clerk to wrap it up. The clerk says it will make a happy little girl. Cerrito replies that he has two daughters. The clerk says that's nice. Cerrito agrees and says two.
related_events: Michael Cerrito examines a doll house
Michael Cerrito closes the door of the doll house
Michael Cerrito picks up the doll house
Michael Cerrito approaches the middle-aged clerk
Michael Cerrito mentions having two daughters

name: Cerrito Buys Dollhouse and Masks
description: Michael Cerrito closes the door of a small dollhouse and carries it to the counter where a middle-aged clerk waits. He sets it down and asks the clerk to wrap it up. The clerk nods and says it will make a happy little girl. Cerrito replies that he has two girls. The clerk says that's nice. Cerrito then asks for the three masks on display—Clark Gable, Three-eyed Monster, and Beautiful Lady. The clerk takes them down and adds the Donald Duck mask as requested. As he hands them over, the clerk laughs and says it's early for Halloween. Cerrito says, 'Halloween's coming early this year,' and asks how much he owes.
related_events: Michael Cerrito requests to purchase three masks and Donald Duck mask
middle-aged clerk removes masks from display and laughs at Cerrito's comment
middle-aged clerk comments on the early Halloween purchase

name: Clerk Asks About Work and Processes Purchase
description: As Chris approaches with a heavy red toolcase, the Clerk moves behind the counter. The Clerk asks what Chris is working on. Chris says he's drilling post holes into concrete. The Clerk looks at the toolcase and remarks that it can ream solid steel. He then asks if Chris wants to check, charge, or cash. Chris chooses cash and asks to have the receipt made out to 'Jack's Fencing.' The Clerk totals the purchase at $788. Chris pays, the Clerk writes the receipt, and comments that fencing must be a good racket, saying he ought to get out from behind the counter. Chris takes the receipt, says 'Yeah,' pauses, then adds 'Take it easy' before leaving with the case.
related_events: Clerk inquires about Chris's work
Clerk comments on the tool's capability
Clerk offers payment options

name: Chris Pays in Cash and Requests Receipt for Jack's Fencing
description: Chris approaches the counter and hands over cash to pay for his purchase. He tells the Clerk to write 'Jack's Fencing' on the receipt. The Clerk rings up the transaction, records the payment of $788, and prints the receipt. Chris takes the receipt, thanks the Clerk, and leaves with a heavy red toolcase.
related_events: Chris pays in cash and requests receipt details
Clerk processes payment and issues receipt

name: Chris Receives Receipt and Leaves After Clerk's Comment
description: Chris takes the receipt from the Clerk, who remarks that drilling post holes into concrete must be a good racket and says he ought to get out from behind the counter. Chris nods and says, 'Yeah,' then adds, 'Take it easy,' before walking away with the heavy red toolcase.
related_events: Clerk expresses desire to leave his job
Chris acknowledges Clerk's comment and departs

name: Elaine Returns from Kitchen with a Kiss
description: Elaine enters from the kitchen and kisses Cerrito. She asks if he is hungry, and he replies that he is starving. She looks at him, searching, and asks if he is okay. He nods, hands her an envelope, and tells her to put it away. Anita whispers a question to her father, then exits to the kitchen. Cerrito sits down, pulls Anita onto his lap, and they begin shouting 'c'mon, c'mon.' Elaine returns with a glass of red wine. Cerrito tells her to open it up, and the children run out. He whispers something to Elaine, who sits on the side of his chair and drapes an arm across his shoulder.
related_events: Elaine Cerrito enters from kitchen and kisses Cerrito
Cerrito gives envelope to Elaine
Cerrito sits down and pulls Anita onto his lap

name: Anita Asks About the Box
description: Anita leans close to her father and whispers, 'Daddy, what's in the box?' Cerrito doesn't answer. Instead, he turns and says, 'Open it up.' The people in the room begin shouting, 'C'mon, c'mon,' and run out.
related_events: Anita whispers question about box to Cerrito
Cerrito tells someone to open the box
People run out of the room

name: Elaine Joins Cerrito with Wine
description: Elaine enters the room holding a glass of red wine. She sits beside Cerrito on the side of his chair and drapes her arm across his shoulder. He leans toward her and whispers something quietly as the activity continues around them.
related_events: Elaine enters with glass of red wine
Cerrito whispers to Elaine while she sits beside him

name: Grillman Cooks Eggs on the Steel Grill
description: Grillman flips the eggs on the quilted steel grill, carefully bastes them, and covers them to cook. The grill is clean and well-kept. He moves with quiet precision, focused on the task. At the other end of the counter, a waiter sits reading a paper while Neil and Eady sit on stools, talking.
related_events: Grillman prepares eggs on a steel grill

name: Neil Talks About His Job Selling Swimming Pools
description: Eady asks Neil what he does. He looks at her, then away, and says he sells swimming pools for institutions—schools, state, and county projects. He works on the sales side. As he finishes speaking, he turns to the grillman and asks for another coffee.
related_events: Neil describes his job selling institutional swimming pools

name: Neil Orders Another Coffee
description: Neil turns to the grillman and says, 'Let me have another coffee.' The grillman nods slightly, already moving to pour the drink. The steam rises in a thin curl as the cup is filled, the sound of the diner humming just beneath the quiet exchange.
related_events: Neil requests another coffee from Grillman

name: Eady Talks About Her Favorite Art Books
description: Neil asks Eady if she likes selling books. She says yes, especially fine art books, and that she studies them. She mentions a Skira edition of Delacroix charcoal sketches she likes, then says she’s interested in Asian artwork. As she speaks, she hesitates slightly and drinks her coffee.
related_events: Eady expresses interest in selling and studying fine art books
Eady mentions interest in a Skira edition of Delacroix charcoal sketches
Eady expresses interest in Asian artwork
Eady hesitantly drinks her coffee

name: Start the Clock and Cut the Steel
description: Neil activates a chronometer with a loud click through his radio earpiece. Inside the armored truck, Chris, wearing a welder's mask, drives a hollow-core drill into the truck's armored plating. The bit tears through the steel with a piercing scream. Neil watches his stopwatch closely—29, 30, 31, 32—counting each second as the drill cuts deeper.
related_events: Neil starts chronometer with loud click via radio earpiece
Chris begins drilling into armored truck with hollow-core drill
Neil monitors stopwatch with precise second count

name: Breaching the Armored Truck
description: Chris finishes cutting through the armored truck with the hollow-core drill, pulls it away, and immediately drops it, raising his shotgun. Cerrito swings a sledgehammer at the circular cut, striking it hard. The metal disc buckles inward and falls into the truck with a heavy clang.
related_events: Chris completes cutting through armored truck with hollow-core drill and readies shotgun
Cerrito strikes cut disc with sledgehammer causing it to fall inward

name: Neil Throws Grenade and Demands Surrender
description: Neil pulls the pin on a grenade and hurls it through the circular breach in the armored truck. The grenade explodes inside, sending out a violent blast and thick smoke. Moments after the detonation, Neil shouts, 'Next one blows you up! Out! Now!' His voice is loud and commanding, cutting through the noise.
related_events: Neil throws live grenade through breach in armored truck
Grenade detonates inside armored truck producing violent explosion and smoke
Neil issues urgent command for occupants to exit armored truck

name: Team Holds Position with Weapons Drawn During Breach
description: Cerrito stands with an AR15 gripped tightly, stock collapsed, eyes fixed on the armored truck. Waingro crouches nearby, his converted 9mm Beretta leveled and ready. Neil keeps his Browning in hand, finger along the trigger guard, scanning for movement. As Chris drives the hollow-core drill into the truck’s side, the high-pitched scream of metal fills the air. The circular cut completes with a shower of sparks. Cerrito swings the sledgehammer—the disc clatters inward. Neil pulls the pin on a grenade and hurls it through the hole. The explosion rocks the vehicle, smoke billowing out. He shouts, 'Next one blows you up! Out! Now!' The team holds their weapons steady, watching the breach point, waiting for movement.
related_events: Team maintains armed readiness during armored truck breach

name: Hanna Confronts Albert at the Apartment
description: Hanna stands in the doorway as daylight spills into the apartment. He shoves Torena hard in the chest, knocking him inside, then steps in after him. 'You were supposed to get back to me last night. So where the fuck were you, Albert?' he demands. Albert stumbles, protesting that he couldn't break free, claiming he spent the night working leads, comparing himself to a flamenco matador. Hanna glares at him, voice tight with anger. 'I oughta violate your ass right now.' He scans the room—religious objects line the mantle, and fourteen stolen TVs sit packed in cases in the dining area. 'You're a bust-out speed freak jackin' metamphetamine again,' he says. A pause. 'I'm in a hurry.'
related_events: Hanna confronts Albert about missed communication
Hanna shoves Torena into the apartment
Hanna threatens to assault Albert

name: Albert Uses a Flamenco Matador Metaphor to Explain His Delay
description: Albert stands in the apartment, breathing heavily after being shoved inside by Hanna. Light from the doorway outlines Hanna’s tense frame as he demands to know why Albert didn’t return the previous night. Albert insists he couldn’t get away, saying he spent the entire night moving through groups of people, cutting in smoothly, gathering leads. He compares himself to a flamenco matador, describing his movements as precise and rhythmic, claiming he was dancing through the streets. As he speaks, Hanna scans the room, taking in the religious objects on the mantle and the fourteen stolen TVs packed in boxes in the dining area. Albert continues, insisting he was working hard, calling himself a dancer. Hanna, unmoved, accuses him of being high on meth again and says he’s in a hurry. Albert shifts the conversation, suggesting Hanna meet his brother Raoul instead, but Hanna demands to see him now. Albert explains Raoul is in Phoenix and can only meet that night at The Zebra on Crenshaw at eleven. He pleads, saying that’s the best he can do. Hanna insists Albert be there too. After a final warning, Hanna leaves, the door closing behind him.
related_events: Albert defends his actions with a flamenco matador analogy

name: Albert Reveals Torena as a Fence
description: Albert tells Hanna that Torena is a Latino fence who deals in stolen goods. He describes Torena as anorexic, and points to the stolen televisions packed in boxes in the dining room. Hanna looks around the apartment, taking in the religious objects on the mantle and the crates of TVs.
related_events: Albert reveals Torena's role as an anorexic Latino fence

name: Hanna Inspects the Apartment and Confronts Albert
description: Hanna steps inside the apartment and looks around. Religious objects cover the mantle. In the dining room, fourteen stolen televisions sit stacked in packing cases. She turns to Albert and says he’s a bust-out speed freak using methamphetamine. The accusation hangs in the air as she declares she’s in a hurry.
related_events: Hanna observes religious objects and stolen televisions in the apartment
Hanna accuses Albert of drug use and being a speed freak

name: Hanna Forces Albert to Set Up and Attend Meeting with Raoul
description: Hanna shoves Albert into the apartment and demands to know why he didn’t return as promised. Albert explains he was out gathering leads, comparing himself to a flamenco matador. Hanna, distrustful and impatient, scans the cluttered apartment filled with religious objects and fourteen stolen TVs packed in cases. Albert tells him his brother Raoul is in Phoenix but will meet tonight at The Zebra on Crenshaw at eleven o’clock. Hanna refuses to wait and insists Albert be there too. Albert pleads that he can’t make it earlier, but Hanna cuts him off, demanding his presence. After securing the details, Hanna leaves the apartment.
related_events: Albert informs Hanna about arranging a meeting with his brother Raoul
Hanna demands Albert be present at the meeting with Raoul
Hanna leaves the apartment after securing the meeting details

name: Neil Subdues Waingro After Ambush
description: Waingro lunges at Neil from behind, crying and trying to speak, but Neil reacts instantly. He drives a knee into Waingro's stomach, sending him doubling over, then slams both palms against his ears before striking him in the face with a sharp knee. Waingro falls onto a car hood and drops to the ground, dazed. Neil kicks him in the side, sending him rolling between parked cars into a more hidden spot. Cerrito and Chris step back, glancing around to watch for onlookers. As Neil draws his .45 and raises it, Cerrito quietly urges him to wait. A police cruiser moves slowly across the street. Neil holds his position until it passes, then turns back—Waingro is gone. Neil, Cerrito, and Chris scan the shadows beneath and between the vehicles, moving cautiously out of the parking lot.
related_events: Waingro attacks Neil from behind in a desperate attempt to explain himself
Neil violently subdues Waingro with a series of precise strikes

name: Kick Waingro into Seclusion
description: Neil kicked Waingro hard in the side, sending him sprawling between two parked cars into a more concealed area. Cerrito and Chris stepped back, scanning the surrounding lot, watching for anyone approaching as Neil moved in.
related_events: Neil kicks Waingro into a secluded area between cars
Cerrito and Chris step back to cover Neil's actions

name: Neil Pauses the Execution Due to Police
description: Neil draws his .45 and aims it at Waingro, who is sprawled and dazed on the ground. Cerrito speaks quietly, urging Neil to wait. Neil hesitates, his eyes shifting as a black and white police cruiser moves slowly across the street. He remains still, watching the cruiser until it passes out of sight. Once it is gone, he turns back toward Waingro, raising the gun again.
related_events: Neil draws his .45 with intent to kill Waingro
Cerrito urges Neil to delay shooting Waingro
Neil notices and waits for a passing police cruiser

name: Neil Finds Waingro Missing After Police Cruiser Passes
description: After the police cruiser moves through the parking lot, Neil turns back toward Waingro, only to find the spot where he had been lying empty. The area appears undisturbed, with no sign of movement. Neil pauses, then begins scanning the rows of parked cars. Cerrito and Chris follow behind him, moving cautiously as they look under and between vehicles. The three of them retreat slowly across the lot, checking shadows and gaps, but Waingro is nowhere to be seen.
related_events: Waingro escapes unnoticed during the standoff
Neil, Cerrito, and Chris search the parking lot for Waingro

name: Hanna Returns Home with a Lamb Chop
description: Hanna comes home and rummages through the remains of dinner, taking a lamb chop and leaving the rest behind. She walks into the living room, where Justine looks up from her book. Justine asks where she’s been. Hanna says she was at work and asks if Harvey showed up or if Lauren got stood up again. Justine replies that Harvey didn’t call and Lauren has been locked in her room all day, refusing to speak. She adds that she isn’t okay either. She tells Hanna she made dinner four hours ago and asks her to at least get a plate. Hanna responds that there are three dead bodies in an alley off Adams. After a pause, she apologizes for the overcooked lamb. Justine looks at her, stands quietly, and walks into the bedroom, closing the door behind her. Hanna stays in the living room, turns on the television, and stares at the news without moving.
related_events: Hanna retrieves a lamb chop from leftover dinner
Justine confronts Hanna about her absence

name: Justine confronts Hanna about the failed dinner and emotional distance
description: Justine sits in the living room reading when Hanna enters, holding a lamb chop from the leftover dinner. Justine asks where Hanna has been, and Hanna says work, then mentions a case involving three dead bodies in an alley off Adams. Justine responds that she made dinner, which has been sitting for four hours, and that Hanna always pulls away when she tries to create a moment between them. She says Lauren was stood up and won’t come out of her room, and adds that she herself is not okay either. Hanna apologizes for the overcooked lamb. Justine looks at him, stands quietly, and walks into the bedroom, closing the door behind her. Hanna remains in the living room, turns on the television, and stares at the news without speaking.
related_events: Justine expresses emotional frustration over rejected intimacy

name: Hanna Reports Bodies, Ignores Tension
description: Justine asks Hanna where she's been. Hanna says she was at work and mentions Harvey stood up Lauren again. Justine says Lauren hasn't come out of her room and that she herself is upset too. She tells Hanna she made dinner hours ago and asks her to at least get a plate. Hanna responds by saying there are three dead bodies in an alley off Adams. She adds that she's sorry the lamb got overcooked. Justine looks at her, stands up quietly, walks into the bedroom, and closes the door. Hanna stays in the living room, turns on the TV to watch the news, and stares blankly at the screen.
related_events: Hanna reports three dead bodies in an alley off Adams

name: Justine Retreats to the Bedroom After Hanna's Remark
description: After Hanna mentions three dead bodies in an alley off Adams, Justine looks at him, rises without speaking, and walks into the bedroom. She closes the door behind her.
related_events: Justine reacts to Hanna's statement and retreats to the bedroom

name: Hanna Regrets His Words and Turns to the TV
description: Hanna stands alone in the living room after Justine walks away and closes the bedroom door. He looks at the closed door, then turns to the television, switches it on, and stares at the screen without moving. The news plays in the background as his expression goes blank.
related_events: Hanna expresses emotional fatigue about caring for Justine
Hanna regrets his words and turns on the TV

name: Hanna Checks the Time and Arms Himself Before Leaving
description: Hanna looks at his watch and tells Justine he can't stay for breakfast because Bosko is waiting. Justine offers to make coffee, but Hanna says he's out of time. As Lauren calls out that her father is picking her up for the day, Hanna clips a 2-inch .38 into his waistband. He mutters about whether Lauren's father will actually show up or stand her up again, just like last time. Justine shrugs, then starts to get out of bed to look for the barrettes. Hanna leaves the room.
related_events: Hanna checks watch and declines breakfast invitation
Hanna expresses skepticism about father's arrival and arms himself

name: Lauren Searches for Barrettes Before Leaving with Her Father
description: Lauren passes the bedroom door, calling out to her mother about her missing barrettes. Hanna greets her and asks if she has school that day. Lauren says her father is picking her up to see the new site, then go shopping and have lunch. She checks the kitchen table but doesn’t find the barrettes there. Justine suggests they were on the table earlier and notes that her father is already late. Lauren remains offscreen, still looking for the barrettes as she prepares to leave.
related_events: Lauren asks mother about missing barrettes
Lauren announces plans with father and notices missing barrettes
Hanna greets Lauren and questions her about school

name: Justine Left Behind After Hanna Leaves
description: Justine starts to get out of bed and offers to make coffee, but Hanna says he’s out of time and leaves. Justine sinks back onto the pillow, the sheet slipping partially off her body. She lies still, looking out the window through the light muslin curtain, her face turned away, breathing out slowly.
related_events: Justine offers coffee and reacts to Hanna's departure
Justine lies exposed and gazes out window in emotional withdrawal

name: Justine Watches Hanna Dress
description: Justine lies in bed beneath white sheets, the tip of a cigarette glowing as she lights it. She watches quietly as Hanna gets dressed, movements deliberate, the room still. The air is close, the silence between them unbroken.
related_events: Justine lights cigarette and watches Hanna dress

name: Man Endures Cold Shower
description: Water streams off his body. The glass is misted. He turns off only the hot water and stands in the cold spray, breathing fast.
related_events: Man breathes heavily in cold shower after turning off hot water

name: Neil and Eady Watch the City at Sunset
description: Neil and Eady stand on a hilltop overlooking the city as the sun sets. Below them, the city spreads out like an ocean of small lights. Eady speaks about mezzotint plates and a Japanese concept called 'sabi,' describing how certain scenes evoke a deep, quiet loneliness—like a flock of geese hovering over a field in mist, just as the leader touches down. They drink scotch from highball glasses. Neil recalls flying over the Arctic at 10,000 feet, the moonlight blue on the snow, saying it felt like this moment. Eady asks if he travels often. He says yes. She asks if he is lonely. He replies that he is alone, but not lonely. He pulls her closer. A red band of pre-dawn light begins to split the horizon. He asks her the same. She says she gets lonely. He holds her face in his hands, looks into her eyes, and she moves toward him.
related_events: Characters observe the city from a hilltop at sunset
Eady reflects on mezzotint plates and the concept of sabi
Characters drink scotch during a reflective conversation

name: Neil and Eady Share a Moment of Quiet Connection
description: They sit together in the house high on the hill, looking down at the city spread out below like an ocean of lights. Neil recalls a flight he once took over the arctic at 10,000 feet, where the moonlight lay blue on the snow. He says it felt like this—looking at the city now. There is a long silence. Eady asks if he travels a lot. He says yes. She asks if he is lonely. He replies that he is alone, but not lonely. She says she gets lonely. He pulls her closer, his hands cradling her face as they look into each other's eyes, then move together as the first red light of dawn breaks the horizon.
related_events: Neil compares the city to a flight over the arctic
Eady asks Neil about his travel habits
Neil clarifies the difference between being alone and lonely

name: Hold Her Face at Dawn
description: A red band of pre-dawn light spreads across the horizon. Neil pulls Eady closer, his hands cradling her face as he looks into her eyes. She tells him she gets lonely. Without breaking the gaze, she moves toward him.
related_events: Red band of pre-dawn light appears on the horizon
Neil pulls Eady closer during their conversation
Neil holds Eady's face and looks into her eyes
Eady admits feeling lonely
Eady moves toward Neil in response to his touch

name: Nate Counts the Stolen Certificates and Pays Neil
description: Planes roar overhead as yellow vapor lamps cast a harsh glow over the parking lot. Neil sits in a gray Lincoln Town Car, wearing a gray suit and white shirt, no tie. Nate, in a yellow rayon shirt, leans over in his silver Mercedes parked beside him, examining a manila envelope pulled from the armored truck. He counts the contents—eighty Treasury Certificates, each worth $20,000. As he tallies the sum, he notes that a million at forty cents on the dollar comes to 640, and hands Neil a large envelope with $140,000 in front money, promising the rest in two or three days. Rechecking the securities, Nate laughs and points out they belong to Malibu Securities, a brokerage tied to a man named John Van Zant. He explains Van Zant may want to buy back the stolen bonds, which could raise the payout to sixty cents on the dollar, adding $320,000 to Neil’s take. Neil tells him to proceed. Nate then mentions a job from a man named Cezar Kelso, saying it could net Neil nearly eight figures and is very clean. Neil declines at first, but after a pause, agrees to meet the next morning at midnight. He starts the car. Nate pulls away in his Mercedes as an L1011 flies low overhead. Neil drives off.
related_events: Nate examines the manila envelope from the armored truck
Nate counts the Treasury Certificates
Nate identifies the securities as belonging to Malibu Securities
Nate hands a large envelope to Neil

name: Nate Recognizes the Stolen Certificates and Proposes a Better Deal
description: Nate examines the manila envelope containing the Treasury Certificates and notices they belong to Malibu Securities. He tells Neil the securities are controlled by John Van Zant, a man involved in brokerage schemes, planned bankruptcies, and money laundering. Realizing the connection, Nate laughs and points out that Neil has stolen Van Zant’s own bonds. He suggests that instead of selling the certificates at 40 cents on the dollar, they could sell them back to Van Zant directly for 60 cents, increasing Neil’s profit by $320,000. Neil agrees to the idea. Nate then mentions a job from a man named Cezar Kelso, saying it could earn Neil nearly eight figures and is very clean. Neil says he’ll meet about it at midnight the next day. Nate tells him to take it easy. Neil starts his car and pulls away, followed by Nate in his Mercedes as a plane roars overhead.
related_events: Nate reveals the plan to sell stolen Treasury Certificates back to the owner

name: Neil Declines to Discuss the Heist
description: Nate hands a manila envelope to Neil and asks what happened during the job. Neil looks at him and says he doesn’t want to talk about it. Nate pauses, then shifts his attention back to the securities, flipping through them before noticing something that makes him laugh. He points out that the Treasury Certificates belong to Malibu Securities, a brokerage controlled by a man named John Van Zant. Neil takes the envelope back, unimpressed. Nate suggests they could get a better price by selling the certificates back to Van Zant, but Neil doesn’t respond. Instead, Nate brings up a new job involving a man named Cezar Kelso. Neil initially resists, saying he has his own plans, but after a pause, agrees to meet the next morning at midnight. He starts the engine, and both men drive off in opposite directions as a plane passes overhead.
related_events: Neil refuses to discuss what happened during the operation

name: Nate Presents a Lucrative Heist Opportunity
description: Nate hands Neil a large envelope after counting the contents of a manila one—eighty Treasury Certificates worth $20,000 each. He points out that the securities belong to Malibu Securities, controlled by a man named John Van Zant, involved in bankruptcies, S&L scandals, and money laundering. Nate laughs, realizing Neil unknowingly stole from Van Zant, and suggests they could get 60 cents on the dollar instead of 40 by selling the certificates back to him, netting an extra $320,000. Then Nate brings up Cezar Kelso, a name Neil knows by reputation. He says Kelso is planning a score and wants Neil to take a look. Neil resists, saying he has his own work, but when Nate claims the job could bring in nearly eight figures and is very clean, Neil agrees. He tells Nate the time: 10:00 a.m. tomorrow. Nate tells him to take it easy. Neil starts the engine of his Lincoln Town Car and pulls away, just as an L1011 roars overhead. Nate drives off in the opposite direction in his silver Mercedes.
related_events: Nate suggests Neil consider Cezar Kelso's heist opportunity
Neil agrees to meet about the new heist proposal

name: Neil and Nate Depart After Meeting
description: Neil starts the engine of his Lincoln Town Car and pulls away from the parking spot. At the same time, Nate drives off in his silver Mercedes. The roar of a passing L1011 overhead fills the air as both cars disappear into the night, leaving the empty lot lit only by the glare of yellow vapor lamps.
related_events: Neil starts the car and departs from the meeting location

name: Charlene Confronts Chris About the Missing Money
description: Charlene counts the money and demands to know where the rest of the $8,000 is. Chris tells her the amount is all that’s left after paying off bookies and another man, and says the rest will come in a couple of days. He checks his watch and says they’re late, slipping on a boot. Charlene argues that the risk isn’t worth $8,000, bringing up the danger to herself, their son Dominick, and their future. Chris interrupts, saying not to worry because Neil has things under control, and urges her to leave. Charlene asks again about the club he promised to open, but Chris dismisses her. She yells that she wants out, and Chris shouts back, pointing to the door and telling her to leave—but to leave Dominick, the bank book, and the car keys on the kitchen table. Charlene says he can keep everything else, but Dominick is going with her. Chris shoves her against the wall, speaks in a low voice, threatening to find and kill her if she ever tries to take their son. He takes the car keys and leaves. She remains frozen in place.
related_events: Charlene questions the missing money from the $8,000
Chris explains the missing money and urges departure

name: Charlene Confronts Chris About the Money and the Danger
description: Charlene counts the money and demands to know where the rest is. Chris tells her that $8,000 is all they have after paying off the bookies and another man, and that the rest will come in a couple of days. He checks his watch and says they’re late. Charlene insists he listen, warning that he could end up dead on the street, that she could be arrested as an accessory, and that their son, Dominick, could wind up in a home—all for $8,000. Her voice breaks as she asks if it’s worth the risk. Chris tells her not to worry, that Neil has things under control, and urges her to leave. Charlene asks where the club he promised is, and Chris mocks her, calling it the 'showgirl with a future' bit. She tells him to shut up, says she left for a good reason, then mutters that she can’t talk to him because he never listens. Chris interrupts, saying he and Neil have plans. Charlene snaps that he’s always talking about 'me and Neil,' even though she’s his wife now. Chris tells her not to mouth off. She screams that she wants out. He shouts back, pointing to the door, telling her to leave but to leave Dominick, the bank book, and the car keys on the kitchen table. Charlene says he can keep the rest, but Dominick is going with her. Chris shoves her against the wall and, in a low voice, threatens to find her and kill her if she ever tries to take their son. He takes the car keys and leaves. She stays frozen in place.
related_events: Charlene expresses fear over the risks involved
Charlene challenges the risk versus reward of the plan

name: Charlene Demands to Leave, Chris Threatens Her
description: Charlene shouts that she wants out of the relationship, her voice breaking as she questions the risk of staying for just eight thousand dollars. Chris yells back, flinging the door open and telling her to go. He demands she leave Dominick, the bank book, and the car keys on the kitchen table. She fires back, saying he can keep everything else but that Dominick is coming with her. Chris shoves her against the wall, speaking in a low, threatening voice, telling her he will find her and kill her if she ever tries to take their son. He grabs the car keys and leaves. She remains frozen in place.
related_events: Charlene declares her desire to leave the relationship
Chris demands Charlene leave but retain specific items

name: Charlene Demands Custody, Chris Responds with Violence
description: After Chris tells her to leave and throws the door open, Charlene declares that Dominick will go with her. Chris shoves her hard against the wall. In a low, steady voice, he tells her he will find her and kill her if she ever tries to take their son. He takes the car keys and leaves. She remains frozen in place.
related_events: Charlene asserts custody claim over Dominick
Chris threatens Charlene if she takes Dominick

name: Cerrito and Waingro Prepare for the Heist
description: Cerrito checks his watch and pulls a paper bag from under the seat. He takes out two rubber masks and a pair of surgical gloves, handing them over. Waingro stubs out his cigarette in quick, sharp jabs and grabs his mask—a beautiful woman’s face. Cerrito slips on his own, the rubber stretching over his features, grotesque with three eyes and a twisted mouth. They pull on the gloves, movements quick and precise. Cerrito shifts the truck into gear and pulls out of the alley.
related_events: Cerrito checks his watch and signals it is time to begin
Waingro nervously stubs out his cigarette
Cerrito distributes rubber masks and surgical gloves from a paper bag
Cerrito and Waingro put on disguises and protective gear

name: Cerrito and Waingro Begin the Pursuit
description: Cerrito pulls the truck out of the alley and steers onto the street. He and Waingro spot an armored truck passing by and fall in behind it, following its path. They turn left, then right, and see the armored truck again—it has turned left as well. Their routes are set to cross at a right angle.
related_events: Cerrito drives the truck out of the alley
Cerrito and Waingro follow an armored truck on the street

name: Cerrito and Waingro Follow the Armored Truck
description: Cerrito pulls the truck out of the alley and drives forward. He turns left while the armored truck continues straight. After a short distance, Cerrito turns right. As they proceed, they see the armored truck again, having turned left at an earlier intersection. The two vehicles are now on paths that will cross at a 90-degree angle.
related_events: Cerrito and Waingro turn left while the armored truck continues straight
Cerrito and Waingro turn right and spot the armored truck again after it turned left
Paths of Cerrito and the armored truck are set to intersect at 90 degrees

name: Cerrito and Waingro Realize the Armored Truck Crew's Plan
description: Cerrito and Waingro follow the armored truck through the city, weaving through side streets. As they turn left, the armored truck passes straight ahead. A moment later, they turn right and see the truck again—it has turned left, their paths crossing at an intersection. Watching its movements, they notice something unusual: the truck is not following its expected route. The way it lingers, the timing of its turns, the lack of communication with dispatch—small details click into place. They exchange a glance. The crew inside isn't just driving. They're setting up a robbery of their own vehicle.
related_events: Cerrito and Waingro realize the armored truck crew is planning an armed robbery

name: Cerrito and Neil Subdue the Armored Truck Crew
description: The door of the armored truck crashes down and swings open. Guard One tumbles out, followed by Guard Two. The Driver exits from his side, but Cerrito immediately grabs him. Neil confronts the two guards, slams them against the wall, and yanks their guns away, taking their 9mms. He presses one gun to the back of each man's head in turn. The Driver tries to twist free, but Cerrito strikes him in the face with the AR15 and forces him against the wall. Cerrito and Waingro stand guard over the three crew members. Neil moves into the truck, joining Chris, who is already inside, tearing through compartments and ignoring cash. Neil checks his stopwatch—it reads twelve seconds. He tells Chris to hurry. Waingro, wearing the Beautiful Lady mask, keeps his gun trained on the guards, shifting it between them. Guard Two, a large and boastful man, speaks quietly, saying Waingro didn’t have the gun before. Waingro reacts, but Cerrito cuts in, telling the guard to shut up. Neil and Chris emerge from the truck holding a single manila envelope. Neil shouts to move out and checks his watch again—seconds remain. Waingro doesn’t respond, fixated on Guard Two. The guard turns and looks at him with arrogance, more focused on pride than fear. Waingro raises his arm and fires. Guard Two is thrown back against the wall, dead. The Driver makes a move, reaching into his boot for a small hammerless .38. Neil spins, fires two shots from his 9mm Browning, and drops him. Cerrito, keeping the AR15 aimed at Guard One, looks to Neil. Neil nods, angry. Cerrito fires three shots, killing Guard One. On the ambulance, Neil grabs Waingro and throws him into the back.
related_events: Cerrito and Neil subdue three guards during armored truck heist
Neil confiscates guns from the two guards
Cerrito disarms and restrains the driver

name: Waingro's Intimidation and Cerrito's Intervention
description: Guard Two, a large and boastful man, questions Waingro's possession of a weapon, speaking quietly but defiantly. Cerrito immediately cuts in, mocking Guard Two's bravado and reminding him that Waingro—and he—have the guns. Waingro, wearing the Beautiful Lady mask, grows fixated on Guard Two. He shouts at him to flatten against the wall and strikes the back of his head with the gun barrel. As the others move to leave, Waingro remains focused on Guard Two, who turns and looks at him with arrogance. Waingro fires, shooting Guard Two and slamming him back against the wall. The Driver makes a sudden move, reaching into his boot for a hidden .38, but Neil spins and shoots him with two quick shots from his 9mm. Cerrito keeps his AR trained on Guard One, who stares silently at the masked men. Neil nods in anger. Cerrito responds by firing three shots, killing Guard One. Neil then throws Waingro into the back of the ambulance as they prepare to leave.
related_events: Guard Two challenges Waingro's authority
Cerrito silences Guard Two's defiance
Waingro threatens guards under Neil's supervision

name: Neil and Chris Search the Armored Truck
description: Neil enters the armored truck and joins Chris, who is already tearing through the interior. They ignore stacks of cash, searching instead for something specific. Neil checks his stopwatch. 'Twelve seconds left,' he says. 'Move it.'
related_events: Neil and Chris search the armored truck interior
Neil warns Chris about remaining time

name: Waingro Shoots Guard Two, Neil Kills Driver, Cerrito Executes Guard One
description: As the crew prepares to leave, Guard Two turns and looks at Waingro with arrogance. Waingro, holding a gun, fires, and Guard Two is thrown back against the wall. At the same moment, the Driver reaches into his boot and pulls out a small hammerless .38. Neil spins, raises his 9mm Browning, and fires two shots, dropping the Driver. Cerrito turns his AR15 toward Guard One, who stands motionless, staring at the masked men. Cerrito glances at Neil, who nods. Cerrito fires three shots, killing Guard One. Neil then grabs Waingro and throws him into the back of the ambulance.

Driver attempts to retrieve hidden firearm from boot
Neil shoots Driver with two rounds from 9mm Browning

name: Neil Throws Waingro into the Ambulance

related_events: Neil throws Waingro into the ambulance

name: Cezar Presents the Heist to Neil
description: Cezar sits across from Neil and lays out a plan to rob a bank that receives large cash deposits every Thursday, timed to support Friday payroll withdrawals from a Toyota and Nissan plant, a steel mill, and two refineries. He demands a $100,000 advance against a total cut of 101, insisting the terms are non-negotiable. Neil questions the value of the score, calling it a reckless run-and-gun job, but Cezar counters that the alarms are neutralized by cutting in through the roof the night before using detailed blueprints, circuit diagrams, and full technical plans. The heist would be a daylight operation, conducted strongly through the front door, with a crew of four—three inside and a driver. Neil asks if anyone needs to be killed; Cezar says it’s unlikely, as two men hold separate keys to the vault. When Neil confirms the availability of architectural, plumbing, electric, and camera layout details, Cezar estimates the haul at $8.1 to $8.2 million. Neil hesitates, absorbing the number. Cezar, satisfied by the reaction, asks where Nate is. Neil says Nate had to make a call, then agrees to the plan, handing over $5,000 as earnest money, with the rest to follow after lunch. They shake hands.
related_events: Cezar pitches heist plan to Neil
Cezar explains target bank's cash schedule
Neil questions financial terms of heist proposal
Cezar specifies heist execution method
Cezar outlines crew composition for heist

name: Neil Questions the Heist Plan
description: Neil asks Cezar whether anyone will have to be killed during the heist. Cezar says he doubts it, explaining that two men hold the keys to the box and both are needed to open it. Neil then asks if he has full architectural, plumbing, and electrical plans, including camera placements. Cezar confirms he has all of it—circuit diagrams, blueprints, everything. He explains that the team will enter through the roof the night before, bypassing three alarms so that when they go off during the robbery, nothing will happen. Neil expresses skepticism about the value of the job for the requested advance, but after hearing the details and the estimated haul of eight point one to eight point two million dollars, he agrees to move forward. Cezar asks where Nate is. Neil says Nate had to make a call. Neil then confirms the deal, hands over five thousand dollars as earnest money, and says the rest will come after lunch. They shake hands.

Neil requests comprehensive facility schematics and surveillance details
Cezar reveals alarm bypass strategy using prior roof entry
Cezar inquires about Nate's whereabouts

Kelso observes Neil's reaction to heist payout with satisfaction

name: Neil Accepts the Heist and Pays Earnest Money

related_events: Neil accepts heist proposal and provides earnest money
Cezar and Neil formalize agreement with handshake

name: Cezar Confirms Vault Plans and Security Details
description: Neil asked if he would have full access to architectural, plumbing, and electrical plans, as well as camera placements. Cezar confirmed he had all of it—circuit diagrams, blueprints, and the works. He explained that two men held the keys to the vault, each required to open it. Neil listened, then asked for the estimated haul. Cezar replied: eight point one, eight point two million dollars. The number hung in the air. Cezar smiled, watching Neil process it. After a beat, Neil said, "You're on." He pulled out five thousand dollars as earnest money and handed it over. They shook hands.
related_events: Cezar confirms dual-key security system for vault access

name: Neil and Eady Meet in the Engineering Section
description: Neil stands in the Engineering section, flipping through a large book filled with full-color plates of electronic micrographs of different kinds of steel. Eady approaches and asks if he needs help. Neil looks up and says no. He asks if the section is closing soon. Eady leans back against a bookcase and says yes, yawning. She asks if he's interested in metals. Neil says no, then adds that he's looking at the color reproduction of the plates. Eady mentions a first edition of Kandinsky's Theory of Color with hand-pulled lithographic prints bound in, and asks if he'd like to see it. Neil says sure. As they start to walk across the store, Eady says she's seen him there before. Neil comments that the store is open late, and not many places are. After a pause, he asks her name. She tells him: Eady Tse. He introduces himself as Bukowski—Neil Bukowski—and holds onto her hand as he looks at her face. They both smile. She laughs, looks away, and they continue toward a locked case at the rear of the store.

Eady offers assistance to Neil
Neil declines Eady's offer of help
Neil inquires if the section is closing soon
Eady confirms upcoming closure and asks about Neil's interest in metals
Neil falsely claims interest in color reproduction of the plates

name: Neil and Eady Exchange Names
description: Neil remarks that the store is open late, noting not many places are open this late. He asks Eady for her name and holds out his hand. She leans back against the bookcase and tells him her name is Eady Tse. She asks for his in return. He says his name is Neil Bukowski, holding onto her hand longer than usual. Eady introduces herself as Eady Tse
Neil falsely introduces himself as Bukowski

name: Neil and Eady Walk to the Rear Display Case

Eady leads the way, her long black hair swaying slightly as she moves. Neil keeps pace, his hand briefly lingering in hers before they both turn their attention forward. The shelves of books narrow around them, the lighting dimmer toward the rear. They stop in front of the case, standing close as Eady prepares to open it.

Neil and Eady share an extended gaze and smile

name: Neil Arrives and Sets Things Straight
description: Neil walks into the diner, crosses the room, and slides into the booth across from Waingro. Chris and Cerrito sit on one side with Waingro alone opposite them. The four men lean in close, speaking in low whispers. Neil pulls out three yellow envelopes, hands them around, making sure Waingro gets his share. He flips one envelope toward Waingro and tells him to leave, his voice quiet but sharp. Waingro stays silent, then mutters that he had to kill the man. Neil reacts instantly, grabbing the back of Waingro’s neck and slamming his face into the table, flicking his temple hard with his finger. He leans in, questioning whether something’s wrong with him, if he’s on drugs. Cerrito glances around the diner—no one is paying attention. Neil tells Waingro he didn’t have to do it, that now there’s more heat on a clean job. Waingro doesn’t respond. Neil shoves him into the corner of the booth, knocking plates to the floor. Without another word, all three men stand and walk out, leaving Waingro behind.

Neil distributes partial money split to group members

name: Neil Pays Off and Expels Waingro
description: Neil enters the coffee shop and slides into the booth across from Waingro. He places three yellow envelopes on the table and explains in a whisper that he has taken money from his own share to cover Waingro's full cut. He speaks about Waingro in the third person, as if he isn't present, and says he wants to settle Waingro's debt and be done with him. Cerrito and Chris exchange glances; Cerrito says, 'Okay,' and Chris nods. Waingro remains silent. Neil flicks an envelope toward him and tells him to leave. Waingro whispers that he had to kill the man, but Neil interrupts, grabs him by the neck, and slams his face into the table. He flicks Waingro's temple repeatedly, asking if he's on drugs, if his head is messed up. Cerrito glances around the diner to see if anyone is watching. Neil accuses Waingro of bringing unnecessary heat on a clean job. He shoves Waingro into the corner of the booth, causing plates to fall. Without another word, Neil, Cerrito, and Chris stand and walk out, leaving Waingro behind.

Cerrito and Chris silently approve Neil's decision regarding Waingro

name: Neil Slams Waingro Into Table in Diner Confrontation
description: After Waingro whispers, 'I had to dust him,' Neil grabs the back of his neck, slams his face into the table, and flicks his temple with his finger. He leans in, whispering questions about drug use—'Electricity and chemicals a little fucked up? You a shooter? Speed? What?'—each word punctuated by another flick. Cerrito glances around the diner, then watches as Neil shoves Waingro into the corner of the booth, sending plates clattering to the floor. Waingro does not move or speak. Neil, Chris, and Cerrito stand and walk out, leaving Waingro behind.

name: Hanna Arrives at the Armored Truck Crime Scene
description: Lieutenant Hanna steps into the alley, where bright lights illuminate the aftermath of the armored truck robbery. Sawhorses marked "crime area" block off the scene. name: Hanna Investigates the Armored Truck Heist
description: Lieutenant Hanna arrives at the crime scene where the bodies of two guards lie in chalk outlines on bloodstained pavement. The armored truck, its side pried open, remains in the alley, surrounded by sawhorses and bright investigation lights. Sergeant Heinz, who secured the scene, reports that masks, guns, and radios were left behind, with no prints recovered. A nearby janitor reported hearing the robbery but could only describe one large and one thin suspect, and mentioned a white tow truck that has not yet been located. Drucker, Hanna’s technician, relays that the janitor heard one guard speaking to a gunman before being shot, and another guard reaching for a weapon when the shooting began. One of the robbers called a guard "slick" before the gunfire. Hanna notes the robbers ignored loose cash, moved with precision, and killed all three guards once the situation turned lethal. He orders Drucker to run the word "slick" through FBI channels, and assigns Casals to review surveillance tapes and divide up known fences, while Bosko investigates how the robbers learned the truck’s route and cargo. Hanna suspects the crew is not local, possibly linked to unsolved high-level burglaries, and believes they were prepared for a stealth assault. He directs his team to check on the guards’ backgrounds and the armored company’s internal procedures, then joins the forensic unit as they begin collecting tire scrapings and measuring bullet trajectories.

name: Hanna Directs the Investigation at the Crime Scene
description: Hanna arrived at the bloodstained alley where the armored truck robbery had taken place. Chalk outlines marked the positions of the fallen guards. He surveyed the scene, then began assigning tasks to his team. Casals, bald and wiry, was told to take the East side and go through surveillance tapes of known contacts. Drucker, already on site, received orders to stay with Forensics and process all physical evidence from the scene. Hanna also instructed him to run the word "slick"—overheard at the scene—through the FBI database. Bosko, the large and imposing officer, was tasked with finding out how the robbers knew the truck’s route and cargo. Hanna questioned whether Gage printed daily routes, who handled the trash, and who had access. He ordered checks on middle management and the three guards, suspecting one might have tipped off the crew. The team dispersed to begin their work as forensic technicians continued collecting tire scrapings and measuring bullet trajectories.

name: Hanna Takes Command at the Crime Scene
description: Bosko asked if the robbery crew was local or from out of town. Hanna replied that they were out-of-town professionals, not local boosters. Heinz questioned whether the case would remain in his jurisdiction. Hanna dismissed the idea, saying the crime’s sophistication made it clear this was no ordinary heist. He confirmed the case would be handed over to the Major Crime division. The team absorbed the news as Hanna began assigning tasks, his tone signaling the investigation was now operating on a different level.

name: Hanna Orders the Investigation Underway
description: Hanna gave the order for his team to begin their work. Casals and Bosko moved off with their assignments, while Drucker stayed near the forensic crew, coordinating with them on evidence collection. The team dispersed to follow leads—checking surveillance tapes, tracing potential informants among the guards, and investigating how the robbers might have learned the truck’s route. Hanna took charge of the downtown contacts, assigning Casals to the East side.
